name: @u1f992/vivliostyle-index
description: A unified plugin for generating indexes in Vivliostyle CLI builds.

scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit --ignoreConfig oxlint.config.ts && oxlint --fix src tests && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.format: tsc --noEmit --ignoreConfig oxfmt.config.ts && oxfmt src tests && npm run format --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:vivliostyle: npm run build && npm test --workspace vivliostyle-e2e

author: Koutaro Mukai
